from pathlib import Path
files = [Path('src/content/posts/the-self-improving-stack.mdx')] + sorted(Path('src/content/posts').glob('self-improving-stack-*.mdx'))
for p in files:

 short = [x for x in paras if len(x.split()) <= 10]
 print(f'{p.name}: paragraphs={len(paras)} short<=10={len(short)}')
